rows.subject: EPS
rows.title: Geophysical Methods for Shallow Ground Investigations
rows.description: This seminar explores case histories of geophysical methods for shallow ground investigations. critical minerals. This course will review these resources, introduce geoscience and

experience of multidisciplinary research for better use of the Earth’s resources.

rows.title: Technology, Risk, and Security Colloquium
rows.description: This interdisciplinary colloquium explores the complex challenges and opportunities that emerging technologies pose to national and international security policy. rows.subject: QTP
rows.title: Theories and Methods in Queer and Trans Praxis

rows.subject: SASIAN
rows.title: Introduction to Sikhism
rows.description: This course is designed to offer students an introduction to the Sikh tradition, from its founding by Guru Nanak in the fifteenth century through the present day. The course is interdisciplinary in nature, combining historical, philosophical, anthropological, and sociological perspectives to develop a broad understanding of Sikh thought and practice in its various aspects. No prior background knowledge of the Sikh tradition is needed to take the course.
